comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: I am looking for the Sash Tunic here. Can anyone recommend a good spot inside this house to use search?

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
I had been wondering much the same. The screenshots from this website were useful as a reference: albrechtdurer.blog32.fc2.com/blog-entry-376.html

I have not pursued the Sash Tunic as yet, but several of the other areas have proven fruitful.

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: Thanks, I had started trying out all the different spots, and as the link also shows, you have to search in the corner immediately left from the entrance. I knew it was the right spot when I started getting some Traveller's notes and Dull cutlass fairly quickly. This is also the spot to get the War Bonnet (not MA item).

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: Sash Tunic - part of "Indigenous North America Clothes" memorial album - can be found in the corner immediately left from the entrance.
